tasks.title: Add agent_thought_chunk handling in acp-session.ts
tasks.description: In acp-session.ts sessionUpdate handler, add an explicit no-op branch for `agent_thought_chunk` events so they are never appended to `agentText`. The event must still be logged to workflow_log (existing unconditional logging after the if/else block handles this). agentText accumulation must only include `agent_message_chunk` content.
acceptanceCriteria: agent_thought_chunk events do NOT append text to agentText
agent_thought_chunk events ARE still logged to workflow_log
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit

tasks.title: Add file-write instruction to self-review prompt
tasks.description: Update `packages/cli/src/agents/prompts/artifacts/self-review.md` to instruct the agent to write its review summary to `{changeDir}/self-review.md`. This mirrors what the review prompt already does for `review.md`. Add an Output Format section at the end specifying the file path and a brief template.
acceptanceCriteria: self-review.md prompt contains instruction to write output to {changeDir}/self-review.md
Instruction includes a clear output format template
Existing review criteria sections are unchanged
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit

tasks.title: Read report from disk file in workflow-controller
tasks.description: Add a helper function `readReportFile(changeDir, filename)` in workflow-controller.ts that reads a file from disk, returning its content if non-empty or null otherwise. Then update plan self-review (line ~235) to read `{changeDir}/self-review.md` as `selfReviewNotes`, and review stage (line ~689) to read `{changeDir}/review.md` as `reviewReport`. Both must fall back to `result.text` when the file is missing or empty.
acceptanceCriteria: Plan self-review reads {changeDir}/self-review.md when it exists and is non-empty
Review stage reads {changeDir}/review.md when it exists and is non-empty
Both stages fall back to result.text when file is missing or empty
Fallback also triggers when file exists but has 0 bytes
Typecheck passes: cd packages/cli && npx tsc --noEmit
tasks.notes: Depends on T-002 because self-review prompt must instruct agent to write the file before the controller can read it.
